findings.summary: The test reminder includes the next due person's name and phone number, contradicting S.webapp.prompts and the NotificationJob invariant that external reminders contain only a link without contact details.

Sending a test reminder counts toward the one-owner-notification-per-local-day limit, so it would suppress that day's real reminder (or the real one would violate the limit), and no NotificationJob/deduplication path is specified for it.
The affordance reads Suggestion and private contact data for an outbound provider message without any policy (ownerOnly/revocation) or preference recheck coverage, unlike other delivery paths.
